taylor: Heads-up: running a quiet-window capacity failover dry-run this Friday 02:00-02:20 UTC targeting routing layers in us-central and eu-west. Purpose: validate automated failover and capacity reclaim before the year-end promo. Expect short p95/p99 jitter; no planned GPU restarts. :memo:

mina: Blast radius? will this affect Dedicated pools or only routing/control-plane?

taylor: Only routing and control-plane; Dedicated GPU serving pools are untouched. We'll flip route weights and exercise emergency fallback policy for ~5m.

jack: Recommend temporary SLO slice to avoid noisy mitigations: bump region token p99 from 1100ms -> 2100ms for 01:55-02:30 UTC. Ops agrees?

oncall-2: Acked. I'll stay on pager and watch canaries. Add a synthetic to detect sustained p95 >3s.

sre-bot: Maintenance ticket created: quietwindow-failover-dryrun-3165004321. Runbook ack required 10m before start.

taylor: Runbook link: https://confluence.internal/ops/quietwindow-failover. Rollback = restore route weights + cancel failover job. Post-mortem if >1% errors for >10m or failover >4m.

mina: Copy. I'll post short note to support if anything notable. Will ping at 30m, 10m, and 2m before start.

taylor: Thanks — closing thread for now; will reopen if blockers appear.
